usedFor: Mini Course Generator tracks learners, and HubSpot opens a deal when “Course Completed” runs “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “Course Completed” in Mini Course Generator, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A learner finishing a course is a buying signal, so sales gets a deal to follow.

watchOut: “Update Deal” needs the deal ID, so keep the ID that “Create Deal” returns.
